issuer: the Iowa Department of Transportation, Motor Vehicle Division
note: Iowa DOT's fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives the Class C operator's licence at $4 a year of its term, and an ID card at $8 for 8 years; its renewal page's expiration table gives eight years from 17 years and 11 months through 72, so the licence is kept as 8 years at $32 ($4 times 8, a product of the page's figures). The full licence page says a full licence, the third step of the graduated licence, is available at 17 (marked "under eighteen" until 18), so it is kept from 17. No youngest age for the card was read.

sources.said: Older than 17 years and 11 months through 72 years Eight years ... Iowa non-operator's ID cards will be issued with an expiration date of eight years.

sources.title: Iowa DOT, Full License
sources.said: A full license is the third and final step of the graduated driver's license (GDL) system. ... Available at age 17.
